PRE-SEED · 2026
The problem

Authenticity is hard to see.

Holistic shoppers can't tell what is authentic, or where it comes from.

  1. 01  Trust gap: Crystals and herbs are sold with no origin data. Child labor in crystal mines is well documented.
  2. 02  Scattered supply: To build one ritual, shoppers jump between Etsy, Amazon, Instagram and local shops.
  3. 03  Retreats are hard to vet: Booking a trusted wellness retreat in Latin America from the US takes weeks of research.
AMARU  /  02
The solution

One trusted home for rituals, tools and retreats.

01Curated marketplace: Vetted sellers of crystals, aromatherapy, natural wellness, tarot and oracles, each with a verified-origin badge.

02Amaru Essentials: Our own line of ritual kits, certified crystals and ceremonial cacao, sourced direct from Latin America.

03Retreats: Book vetted wellness retreats in Colombia, Peru, Costa Rica and Mexico on the same site.
